individual-data-points.explanation: Spatial deconvolution heatmaps display per-spot values across the tissue section, not an averaged summary statistic requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel B is a box plot, which already displays the distribution of the data (quartiles, median, min/max); box/violin plots are exempt from this check.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots; overlaying individual points is not applicable/would be unreadable, so line plots are exempt.
The bar graph shows a single computed log2 fold-change statistic per gene from a DEG analysis (not an average of multiple replicate measurements), so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel E consists of representative H&E and IHC micrographs, not a quantitative plot of averaged values.
